To say that filmmaker Mike Flanagan is no stranger to bestselling author Stephen King's literary universe would be an understatement, to say the least. Look no further than his upcoming series take on King's classic 1974 novel Carrie, with buzz growing over Flanagan's unique vision and willingness to take some amazing creative swings. But when it comes to King, Flanagan's biggest challenge still lies ahead: his, Trevor Macy, and Intrepid Pictures' television series and film adaptation of "The Dark Tower" universe. Not only is King's fantasy-adventure-horror series epic in and of itself, but it also serves as the connective core to all of King's works. Yeah, it's big. The good news? Flanagan says the adaptation is still "very much on the table," but there have been some speed bumps along the way.
...
"To do it the way I wanna do it requires an enormous commitment from a studio," Flanagan shared with EW during an interview in support of Carrie. While Flanagan's move to Amazon after a successful creative run at Netflix didn't make matters any easier, an "enormous commitment" that Flanagan references has to do with locking down rights to certain King characters. "The way the Dark Tower universe is connected, you've got characters in there that are all over the place when it comes to studio ownership. So the development process on it has been epic. ...
A four-panel manga adaptation by Matsuri Muramatsu will also be published by Kodansha later this year.
...

# ICv2: Marvel Announces 'Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man' Season 2 Miniseries
...
ICv2: Marvel Announces 'Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man' Season 2 Miniseries

Tie-In Ahead of Season 2 of Disney+ Series

Posted by Brigid Alverson on September 21, 2026 @ 12:46 pm CT

 

Marvel will publish a four-issue miniseries tying in with the Disney+ show Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man, set between the first season of the show, which launched in January 2025, and the second, which will launch in January 2027. The miniseries will reunite the creative team of writer Christos Gage and artist Eric Gapstur, who wrote a five-issue prequel before the show premiered (see “ Prequel Comic”). Like the first one, the new miniseries will be tied into the show’s continuity. “Just like last time, showrunner Jeff Trammell has been incredibly generous about coordinating in a way that makes our story a firm part of the show's continuity,” Gage said in a statement accompanying the announcement, adding, “It's a real pleasure to be a part of this take on Spidey that combines the feel of the Silver Age with new and exciting characters and situations. I hope I get to do it again next year!”
...
The first issue of Season 2 of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man will go on sale on December 9, 2026, with covers by Leonardo Romero, Luciano Vecchio, and David Baldeón.

Kodansha published both, with the first series running from July 1994 to March 1995 and the sequel from July 1995 to April 1996. Kodansha has published a total of 3 volumes each. The upcoming Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden TV anime revealed today that the new voice unit Magic Vision Girls Party will perform the official ending theme song for the show, which is entitled “Tokimeki Un Deux Trois”. 【画像】兎山悟&大福が変身!公開された場面カット&設定画

 “かりんの庭”に響く、キラッキランランな歌声につられてやってきた、あんなたちの前には、キュアアイドル／咲良うたや、キュアウインク／蒼風なな、キュアキュンキュン／紫雨こころの姿が。さらに、ポチタンがプリルンやメロロンと仲良くなる、はなまるかわいい様子も映し出されている。 

 そして、元気いっぱい駆け出すキュアワンダフル／犬飼こむぎと、その勢いに引っ張られるようにやってくるキュアフレンディ／犬飼いろはの姿も。こむぎと顔を合わせるポチタンの、素敵でわんだふる～！なカットから、息を切らしながら駆けつけるキュアニャミー／猫屋敷ユキとキュアリリアン／猫屋敷まゆ、兎山悟と大福の姿までさまざまなシーンが切り取られている。 

 公開3日間で興収4.４億円、動員 35.7万人を突破し、『プリキュア』シリーズ史上最高のオープニング成績を記録するなど、好調な滑り出しを見せている『映画名探偵プリキュア！』だが、ヒットを記念して兎山悟役の寺島拓篤と大福役の中村悠一からのコメントも到着した。

# 尾上松也版・金田一耕助が「八つの掟」を案内 『八つ墓村』異色のマナーCM風映像公開 

横溝正史の同名小説を完全新作として映画化した『八つ墓村』（公開中）から、尾上松也演じる金田一耕助らが、劇場で守るべき「八つの掟（おきて）」を紹介するマナーCM風映像が公開された。 

金田一耕助（尾上松也）、井川辰弥（奥智哉）＝映画『八つ墓村』（9月18日公開） ©2026「八つ墓村」製作委員会 ©Yokomizo Seishi/KADOKAWA 

写真ページを見る

 映像では、一般的な劇場マナーに加え、「上映中の歯磨きは厳禁」「劇場内での舞の披露は禁止」「急に後ろの人を見ないこと」など、一風変わった謎の注意事項が登場。作品の怪奇的な世界観にユーモアを織り交ぜた内容となっている。 

 原作は、横溝の代表作の一つ。名探偵・金田一耕助の初登場から80周年の節目に製作された本作では、「呪怨」シリーズや「恐怖の村」シリーズを手がけた清水崇監督が、物語を“怪奇幻想ロマン冒険譚”として再構築した。 物語の舞台は、戦国時代に落ち武者8人が惨殺されたという伝説が残る八つ墓村。亡き母のルーツをたどって村を訪れた青年・井川辰弥（奥智哉）が、次々と起こる殺人事件に巻き込まれていく。金田一は岡山県警の磯川警部（小籔千豊）とともに、村に隠された因縁と事件の真相を追う。 歴代さまざまな俳優が演じてきた金田一耕助役を、歌舞伎俳優の松也が担当。公開後にはSNS上で、「突き抜けた面白さ！さすが清水崇監督!!」「これはこれで良い！尾上松也の金田一がハマってる」「過去作品との違いが新鮮」「しっかり怖いのにレーティングがGだから高校生くらいの子がたくさんいて驚いた。横溝が新世代に届いてうれしい！」など、これまでとは異なる金田一像や、清水監督によるホラー演出を評価する感想が寄せられている。

The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System (Tsuiho Sareta Tensei Ju Kishi wa Gemu Chishiki de Muso Suru) is originally a Japanese light novel series by Nekoko, featuring illustrations by Jyaian. It first began on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in April 2021, while Kodansha acquired it and began publishing it in June 2022. The manga adaptation by Lee Brocco began on Kodansha’s YanMaga Web website and app in February 2022, while it was transferred to Weekly Young Magazine in September 2024. The story follows Elma, an MC who knows that the world he lives in is the same as the one of a game he used to play. While others underestimate it, he knows that the Heavy Knight class is the most powerful one, and he uses the memories from his past life to ‘game the system’ and effectively conquer the entire world.

# The Beginning After the End Author TurtleMe Addresses Tapas Shutdown, Says Future of Series Is Unclear

 Written by Marko Jovanovic September 23, 2026 

 

The Beginning After the End (TBATE) creator TurtleMe has addressed the reported shutdown of Tapas, saying he is still trying to understand what the decision means for his ongoing works.
...
“I’m still trying to understand what exactly is going on, but suffice to say, I’m still in shock,” he wrote, adding that he does not yet know what comes next and is working to determine the situation with Tapas.
...
Despite the uncertainty, TurtleMe said he intends to do everything he can to keep his series going. He also noted that many other Tapas creators remain unsure about what will happen to their works following the platform’s closure. You can read his full message below.

 

The comments follow the news that Kakao Entertainment plans to shut down Tapas as part of a plan to consolidate its webtoon and web novel business. In South Korea, the company is also preparing to discontinue Kakao Webtoon and merge its services into KakaoPage by the end of 2026.
...
We previously had a chance to interview TurtleMe ahead of the series’ anime adaptation, and he told us that Crunchyroll had been “instrumental in bridging the creative vision with global reach.” Last year, the author also announced a Kickstarter campaign for the print edition of the first 3 volumes.
...
Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, describing the story: After a mysterious death, King Grey is reborn as Arthur Leywin on the magical continent of Dicathen. Although he enters his second life as a baby, his previous wisdom remains. He begins to master magic and forge his own path as the years go by, seeking to correct the mistakes of his past life.

icv2.com/articles/news/view/63442/longti.title: ICv2: Longtime Marvel Exec Dan Buckley on the Future of Comics
icv2.com/articles/news/view/63442/longti.excerpt:
An ICv2 Release. Attendees at the ICv2 Insider Talks at New York Comic Con can hear from longtime Marvel executive Dan Buckley on the future of comics in a discussion moderated by ComicsBeat and Publishers Weekly’s Heidi MacDonald. Among the topics planned for discussion are the future roles of the various comic formats in the future, the evolution of the customer base, the evolution of the channels for comics, and the impact of the ever-stronger interaction of storylines from print and from other media on the business. Buckley, who will be moving on from Marvel in 2027 (see " Buckley Moves On") had a big impact on the company during his tenure, which was recognized by Marvel Studios President and Chief Creative Officer Kevin Feige in a statement accompanying the announcement of Buckley’s departure. "From events like Civil War, Secret Wars, X-Men: Age of Krakoa, and the soon-to-be released Marvel Midnight imprint, to the expansion into video games, television, animation and more, Marvel's influence on popular culture expanded under Dan's leadership, bringing our characters and stories to new fans around the world," he said. " Dan has left a lasting mark on Marvel's legacy and on the comics industry, and I'm deeply grateful to him and pleased we will have his full support through this transition." Buckley has a long association with ICv2 conferences at New York Comic Con, participating in multiple events beginning in 2008, when he was a panelist in a panel on Graphic Novels and Tweens at the ICv2 Graphic Novel Conference (see " ICv2 Graphic Novel Conference"). The ICv2 Insider Talks: The Future of Fandom, an industry event for business and creative professionals, will be held from 3:00-6:00 p.m. on Thursday, October 8 in the dramatic 4th Floor River Pavilion at the Javits Center, in association with New York Comic Con. The Future of Comics (4:00-4:30 p.m.) During his time at Marvel, including a 22-year stretch as President and Publisher, current Head of Marvel Comics & Franchise Dan Buckley has been at the center of American comic publishing and the expansion of comics into a major force in the popular culture. As he helps navigate Marvel to a new leadership era and a new base in Burbank, he sits down with Eisner Award-winning journalist Heidi MacDonald (ComicsBeat, Publishers Weekly) to look ahead to the future of comics.

daredevil_born_again_season3_end.summary: Stephen Amell posted a cryptic Instagram video featuring a Green Arrow wanted poster, prompting fan speculation about his possible return to the role.
highlights: Amell’s Instagram video shows him eyeing a hand‑drawn Green Arrow wanted poster
His caption reads “Just when I think I’m out”, hinting at a potential comeback
The post has generated widespread fan discussion about a possible cameo or new DC project
daredevil_born_again_season3_end.why_it_matters: A return of Amell would link the beloved Arrowverse to the new DCU, impacting fan expectations for future crossovers.

jojo_steel_ball_run_trailer_2026.headline: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run
jojo_steel_ball_run_trailer_2026.summary: Netflix released a special recap trailer ahead of the weekly release of new Steel Ball Run episodes starting September 25, 2026.
highlights: The recap trailer highlights key scenes from Stage 1 to prep fans for Stages 2 and 3
The upcoming arc will consist of 11 weekly episodes covering the second and third stages of the race
The series returns to Netflix with a weekly schedule after fan backlash over the initial special episode
jojo_steel_ball_run_trailer_2026.why_it_matters: The trailer signals the continuation of a long‑awaited adaptation, re‑engaging the franchise’s global fanbase.

sequel_s_biggest_horror_movie_just_got_a.headline: Expelled from Paradise: Resonance of the Heart
sequel_s_biggest_horror_movie_just_got_a.summary: The sequel to the 2014 anime film Expelled from Paradise will debut in Japanese cinemas on November 13, 2026.
highlights: A new teaser trailer and visual have been released
Voice actor Rie Kugimiya returns as Angela Balzac
Sumire Morihoshi joins the cast as new character Penem
The film reunites director Seiji Mizushima and writer Gen Urobuchi
sequel_s_biggest_horror_movie_just_got_a.why_it_matters: It continues the acclaimed sci‑fi franchise with returning talent and a fresh storyline for fans.

ani_one_asia_licenses_iceblade_sorcerer_.headline: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Season 2
ani_one_asia_licenses_iceblade_sorcerer_.summary: Ani‑One Asia has licensed the second season of The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World, set to stream across Southeast Asia in October.
highlights: Zero‑G takes over animation from Cloud Hearts for the new season
Returning director Masahiro Takata also serves as scriptwriter and sound director
New character designer Mariko Kawamoto replaces Makoto Shimojima
Opening theme "Diamond Dust" performed by Sizuk
ani_one_asia_licenses_iceblade_sorcerer_.why_it_matters: The change in animation studio and staff signals a fresh visual direction for a popular light‑novel adaptation.

grand_blue_4th_season_production.headline: Foodies
grand_blue_4th_season_production.summary: Kodansha’s Comic Days platform posted the final chapter of Tadashi Agi and Jun Nakanishi’s Foodies manga on September 16, 2026, ending the series.
highlights: The final chapter was released on Comic Days on September 16, 2026
The chapter will become free to read on September 30, 2026
Foodies launched on Comic Days in August 2025 and has released four compiled volumes, the latest on July 17, 2026
grand_blue_4th_season_production.why_it_matters: The conclusion wraps up a popular gourmet‑themed series by prolific writer Tadashi Agi, offering fans closure and free access to the finale.

batman_knightfall_part2_trailer.headline: The Avengers – Deleted Scene “Steve Rogers: A Man Out of Time”
batman_knightfall_part2_trailer.summary: A three‑minute deleted scene from The Avengers, revealed on the 2012 Blu‑ray release, provides the original setup for Steve’s emotional arc that was later re‑created in Captain America: The Winter Soldier.
highlights: The scene shows Steve Rogers reviewing deceased teammates’ files, including a live‑address for Peggy Carter
It was included on the September 2012 Blu‑ray as part of fifteen minutes of deleted material
The payoff of the scene appears in the theatrical cut via the waitress Beth, but the setup was missing until the later film
Director Joss Whedman confirmed he regretted cutting the scene, calling it essential character work
batman_knightfall_part2_trailer.why_it_matters: The deleted scene illustrates how the MCU had to rebuild a key emotional moment in a later movie, highlighting the importance of cut footage in shaping the franchise’s storytelling.

dc_robins_casting_movie.headline: Dynamic Duo
dc_robins_casting_movie.summary: An upcoming DC animated film will explore the origins of Dick Grayson and Jason Todd, with reported voice casting for both characters.
highlights: Mason Thames is reported to voice Dick Grayson
Logan Kim is reported to voice Jason Todd
The film is directed by Arthur Mintz and uses Swaybox’s TiNK facial animation system
Dynamic Duo is slated for a theatrical release on June 30, 2028
dc_robins_casting_movie.why_it_matters: It marks a major addition to the DC Elseworlds animated lineup, focusing on the iconic Robins and their divergent paths.

james_gunn_dcu_tv_release_window_2026_09.headline: The People V. Gorilla Grodd
james_gunn_dcu_tv_release_window_2026_09.summary: James Gunn confirmed that the upcoming DCU TV series The People V.
highlights: The series is a true‑crime comedy featuring the Gorilla Grodd antagonist
It is scheduled to release after the Man of Tomorrow film, which is set for July 9, 2027
Production revealed the use of a fully practical gorilla suit on set
james_gunn_dcu_tv_release_window_2026_09.why_it_matters: It sets the timeline for the next major DCU television event, indicating a long gap for fans after the current hit series Lanterns.

jojo_steel_ball_run_2026_season2.headline: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run – New Opening Theme “SPIN” Released
jojo_steel_ball_run_2026_season2.summary: The anime’s new opening theme “SPIN” by Kroi has been released ahead of the Fall 2026 return of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run on Netflix.
highlights: The opening theme “SPIN” performed by Kroi was unveiled early to promote the upcoming episodes
Steel Ball Run 2nd & 3rd Stages will premiere on Netflix worldwide on September 25, 2026 with weekly Friday releases
New Japanese voice cast members include Tomoaki Maeno, Tomokazu Sugita, and Yoko Hikasa
jojo_steel_ball_run_2026_season2.why_it_matters: The early release of the opening song heightens anticipation for the series’ weekly rollout on a global platform.

ray_gunn_trailer_release.headline: Ray Gunn
ray_gunn_trailer_release.summary: Netflix released the official trailer for Brad Bird’s original animated sci‑fi detective film Ray Gunn.
highlights: The trailer showcases the 1939‑era futuristic city of Metropia
Stars Sam Rockwell as detective Raymond Gunn and Scarlett Johansson as Venus Nova
Directed by Oscar‑winner Brad Bird, known for The Incredibles and Ratatouille
ray_gunn_trailer_release.why_it_matters: It marks a high‑profile original animated release from Netflix, challenging Disney’s sequel‑heavy strategy.

big_crunchyroll_isekai_confirms_finale_m.headline: Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 Finale
big_crunchyroll_isekai_confirms_finale_m.summary: Re:Zero Season 4 will conclude with an extended‑runtime Episode 19 on September 30, 2026, streaming exclusively on Crunchyroll.
highlights: Episode 19 airs on September 30, 2026
The final episode will run 45 minutes, double the usual length
The season ends with a total of 20 episodes after the extended finale
big_crunchyroll_isekai_confirms_finale_m.why_it_matters: The longer finale gives fans a more expansive conclusion to the Recapture Arc and caps the series’ 10th‑anniversary celebration.

one_prime_video_s_biggest_anime_confirms.headline: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
one_prime_video_s_biggest_anime_confirms.summary: The Prime Video anime adaptation of Shigeru Sagazaki’s From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman has confirmed a third season.
highlights: Season 3 has been officially announced following the conclusion of Season 2
A first‑look image for Season 3 was released
The series streams exclusively on Prime Video
No release window or date has been set yet
one_prime_video_s_biggest_anime_confirms.why_it_matters: The continuation shows Prime Video’s growing commitment to exclusive anime series, expanding options beyond traditional platforms.

absolute_universe_25_roundup.headline: Absolute Wonder Woman #24
absolute_universe_25_roundup.summary: Absolute Wonder Woman #24, written by Kelly Thompson and illustrated by Hayden Sherman, hits shelves with heightened emotional stakes for Diana.
highlights: Writer Kelly Thompson delivers her strongest Absolute Wonder Woman issue yet
Artist Hayden Sherman and colorist Jordie Bellaire showcase detailed artwork and vibrant colors
The issue deepens Diana’s emotional turmoil amid the disappearance of Dr. Minerva and her mother
Introduces the twin gods of fear, Phobos and Deimos, adding mythic pressure to Wonder Woman’s story
absolute_universe_25_roundup.why_it_matters: The issue pushes the Absolute Universe toward its upcoming #25 climax, setting up major character developments.

cyberpunk_edgerunners_2_trailer_2026_09_.headline: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
cyberpunk_edgerunners_2_trailer_2026_09_.summary: A new sneak‑peek trailer for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 showcases the character Weak Kingsley and confirms a October 20, 2026 Netflix premiere.
highlights: The 10‑episode sequel is animated by Studio TRIGGER and directed by Kai Ikarashi
Character designer Ichigo Kanno and screenwriter Masahiko Otsuka are attached to the project
Showrunner Bartosz Sztybor returns as writer and producer
Netflix will stream the series worldwide on October 20, 2026
cyberpunk_edgerunners_2_trailer_2026_09_.why_it_matters: The trailer reveals new characters and confirms the continuation of the acclaimed cyber‑punk anime universe for fans of the game and original series.

dungeons_dragons_honor_among_thieves_seq.headline: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves – Sequel Script Exists but Funding Remains Unsecured
dungeons_dragons_honor_among_thieves_seq.summary: A sequel script for Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves is completed, but Hasbro lacks a financial partner to fund a comparable production budget.
highlights: Filmmakers John Francis Daley and Jonathan Goldstein have a finished script for a sequel
Hasbro remains supportive but cannot finance a $150 million‑scale film on its own
Paramount is no longer interested, leaving the project without a distribution partner
The sequel may ultimately be realized as a comic‑book adaptation rather than a live‑action film
dungeons_dragons_honor_among_thieves_seq.why_it_matters: Fans of the original film are eager for a continuation, yet the high cost barrier threatens its realization.

Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Releases Creditless Twelfth Ending Featuring "Aoi Yume" Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its twelfth ending, featuring the song “Aoi Yume” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 140-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
The release follows yesterday’s release of the eleventh ending, featuring the song “Smile for…” by Ueto Aya. The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.
These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.
The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.
The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 Conan the Barbarian has just made his triumphant return with an exciting new release perfect for fans of the sword-and-sorcery icon. A stunning eighth new omnibus is now on sale from Titan Comics.
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol.8 was released on Sept. 8 with over one thousand pages of digitally remastered artwork and a host of bonus material. The high-quality release collects Savage Sword of Conan (1974) #102-116 as well as Marvel Comics Super Special (1977) #35 in a beautiful and deluxe hardcover format. It picks up the story directly from where the seventh omnibus left off, so Conan fans looking to complete their collection will definitely want to pick up the new release, which has a suggested retail price of $150.

2026 World Webtoon Awards Announces 20 Finalists, Opens Global Reader Vote Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on Thursday the 20 finalists for the 2026 World Webtoon Awards.
Now in their third year, the awards will accept online votes from readers worldwide from September 17 to October 19. Judges' scores and reader votes will each account for 50% of the final score.
This year's awards received 7,318 nominations from 4,038 fans worldwide, with 941 works submitted in total.
For the first time, the awards will also offer cash prizes. The grand prize winner will receive 15 million won (about US$10,700), while the Judges' Award winner will receive 13 million won (about US$9,400) and other main award winners will receive 10 million won (about US$7,200) each.
The awards ceremony will take place on December 3 at Starfield Library in COEX Mall, Seoul, as part of the World Webtoon Festival, which runs from December 2 to 6.

Bride of the Barrier Master TV Anime Cast Reveal News
Bride of the Barrier Master TV Anime Reveals 5 More Cast in New Teaser Video
posted on  by Joanna Cayanan
Kadokawa revealed on Monday a new teaser promotional video, third teaser visual, and additional cast members for the television anime of Kureha's Bride of the Barrier Master (Kekkaishi no Ichirinka) light novel series. Kadokawa also announced that the anime will stream on Netflix and on other streaming platforms.
Additional new cast members include:
Kanon Takao as Hazuki Ichise, Hana's twin sister
Hiroto Shimizu as Nozomi Ichinomiya, Saku's younger brother
Yuzuki Tamukai as Azuha, Hana's shikigami that rests on her hair like an ornament
Taihi Kimura as Aoi, a shikigami in human form created by Hana
M.A.O as Miyabi, another shikigami in human form created by Hana
The anime will star Akari Kitō as Hana Ichise and Kikunosuke Toya as Saku Ichinomiya.
Tōru Kitahata (Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It, Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!, Hinako Note) is directing the anime at TROYCA. The full synopsis says, “Your favorite web-slinger is back! Peter Parker is ready to save the world thwip by thwip! But things aren’t perfect. He’s been drifting away from his friends. And Norman Osborn may be out of the spider business, but Harry doesn’t think things are over just yet. Something’s happening at Oscorp, and Spidey and his friends need to figure out what it is!”
Gage comments, “I’m beyond excited to return to the world of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man! Just like last time, showrunner Jeff Trammell has been incredibly generous about coordinating in a way that makes our story a firm part of the show’s continuity.”

Batman: Knightfall Part 2 – Knightquest DC Studios has released the first trailer for Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest, the second chapter in the animated Batman: Knightfall movie trilogy. The new R-rated movie continues the story begun in Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall, which released in August.
As seen in the trailer, Knightquest picks up after Batman and Bane's brutal fight that left Bruce Wayne with a broken back. In the aftermath, Bane declares dominion over Gotham City and releases many of Batman's greatest villains back into the public. To fight back, Bruce passes the mantle to another, Jean-Paul Valley, the religiously zealous vigilante known as Azrael, which comes as a disappointing shock to both Nightwing and Robin.
In the trailer, Azrael dishes out ruthless, brutal, violent justice to criminals, first in Batman's traditional cape and cowl before transitioning to a suit of Batman armor. Check out the trailer below.

Under the National Quiz Law, any contestant who survives the quiz can have virtually any wish granted by the government — wealth, fame, the death of an enemy, the erasure of a criminal record, even ownership of a national landmark. Akira Failing in Love Akira returns to the countryside for high school with a plan to win the heart of her childhood crush! They're both fools in love… because she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!
Harekawa launched the manga in Weekly Shonen Sunday in August 2024. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in December 2024, and the eighth volume on September 16. Viz Media published the manga's fourth volume on September 8.
Kadokawa published one compiled book volume of Senpai, This Can't Be Love! in July 2019. Yen Pressreleased the manga in English in June 2024.
Kadokawa published the first volume of Sempai! Danjite Koi de wa! Brush up sequel manga in September 2020, and the second volume in May 2023. Yen Press released the sequel manga's first volume in December 2024.
Harekawa launched the Three Exorcism Siblings (Tengu Barai no San Kyōdai) manga in Coamix's Web Comic Zenyon in 2021. Coamix published the manga's first volume in 2022, and the seventh and final volume in September 2023. Titan Comicslicensed the manga and published the fourth volume in English on July 28.
